title: Text models reshuffled, FLUX routing adjusted
summary:
GPT-5 Nano became the default `openai` model, FLUX routing got fallbacks, and two community projects joined the listings.

The default `openai` model was changed to GPT-5 Nano, while `openai-fast` remains on GPT-4.1 Nano. Public model listings exclude hidden models and provider identifiers, several older model entries were removed, and `openai-large` moved to the seed tier. For `flux` image requests, registered ComfyUI servers became the first choice, with Cloudflare fallbacks and progress updates for each fallback.

The Creative Projects list gained a bilingual AI Image Generator with prompt optimization and progress display. Hack & Build gained AI Agent Portal, where Architect, Coder, and QA agents collaborate on development tasks from a single prompt.

A SECURITY.md policy was added to explain how to report vulnerabilities privately, what information to include, and how maintainers handle responses and reporter credit.

highlights.title: GPT-5 Nano becomes the default
highlights.text: The `openai` text model is updated to GPT-5 Nano; `openai-fast` keeps GPT-4.1 Nano. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai).
